args.body: After confirming the renewed lease, finish the existing CAD intake handoff using the completed text-only rehearsal. Commit and read back two copy-ready EN/FR responses: one for a diagnostic-only inquiry and one nonbinding clarification for an explicit commission request. The clarification can be finished before the separate terms proposal lands. If that proposal is already committed, cite its exact hash and distinguish proposed terms from operator-approved terms. Keep eligibility, delivery, administrative order acceptance, deposit attestation and Treasury posting separate. Close with a lesson after reading the evidence. No external send or order creation.
